notes.title: Maskmaker Update patch - September 2023
notes.notes:
General :

 Fixed issue in the Archipelago, Desert and Mine levels to handle some edge-case falls
 Fixed collision issue in the Moutain level that was allowing players to fall in the void
 Fixed collision issue in the Forest and Swamp levels that was allowing players to go out of bounds


Improvements :

 Freemove navigation improvements in the Forest level related to the baskets
 Fixed an issue that was causing some texts in menus to display in the wrong size
 Graphic improvement in the Forest level allowing better shadows rendering


That's all for now, hope you'll enjoy this small update!

notes.title: May Maskmaker Update
notes.notes:
Fixed a few edge-case respawn and collision issues in the Desert and Forest levels.  
Fixed a few save system logic issues in the Archipelago and Mountain levels. 
Minor improvements to component positioning for Swamp masks. 
Minor visual improvements to the popup menus. 
Increased smooth turn speed.

notes.title: April Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed crash when starting the game on Oculus Rift/Quest devices. 
 Fixed Hand mesh offset on Valve Index. 
 Fine-tuned joystick input angles - issue with snapturn and 180 that turn could be triggered inadvertently. 
 Fixed issue when freemove was set to "off" in the settings freezing characters in space. 
 Fixed collision issue in the Mountain level, specifically nearby the Billygoat shearing house. 
 Fixed save system for first windmill/cable-car puzzle with pieces stuck in the Mountain level. 
 Collision issue with the first gate after opening it in the Desert level (may require a new game start). 
 Minor visual improvements.
